mcqs.question: When Bulgaria replaced the lev with the euro, which distinction did it attain within the European Union?
options: It became the 21st EU country to adopt the euro
It became an EU member in 2007
Its capital was designated as Sofia
The European Central Bank was formed in 1998
mcqs.explanation: Bulgaria became the 21st EU country to adopt the euro after replacing the lev. The statement that it became an EU member in 2007 refers to its membership history, not the distinction associated with euro adoption.
